defect: independent source and destination reset ordering is unspecified
rationale: The request and acknowledgement toggles use independent resets, while correctness depends on the system contract that both domains reset together or preserve protocol state across a one-sided reset; that ordering and preservation contract is not given.

mutation.description: Reduced the request/acknowledge crossing while retaining separate source and destination reset inputs.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the handshake to toggle request and acknowledgement state with two-stage crossings.
